scope: Bounded framing audit of ISO 32000-2:2020 + EC3 §§12.8, 12.8.2, 12.8.2.1, 12.8.2.2, 12.8.2.2.1, 12.8.2.2.2, 12.8.3, 12.8.3.1, 12.8.3.3, 12.8.3.3.1, 12.8.3.4, 12.8.3.4.1, and 12.8.4/.4.1 and 12.8.5. Not a recertification of signature algorithms, PAdES requirements §§12.8.3.4.2–.8, revocation, trust policy, VRI/DSS, or all DTS edge cases.
source: doc/ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.pdf; physical page = printed page + 15. Effective EC3 checked against doc/errata-read.md and actual PDF annotations. Relevant #152 changes Table 257 /P to integer. #55 is a producer ordering correction; it does not establish a reader rejection/report obligation.

features.source_requirement: No standalone requirement is stated in this heading; ledger status is aggregate-only.
features.assertion_quality: No independent test should be attributed to the heading itself.

features.source_requirement: Transform methods and parameters determine which objects enter revision comparison; DocMDP, FieldMDP, and UR are separate methods with distinct roles.
features.assertions: signature.rs::a_certification_signature_states_what_may_change_after_it; revision.rs ranking and transition tests; restriction and notes consumer tests. The test bodies distinguish selected modifications and permitted/refused operations.
features.limitation: An existing real DocMDP P=1 plus DTS-only incremental-update public test is tracked separately as B18 and fails comparison. This audit does not treat aggregate ledger status as proof that every carveout works.

features.source_requirement: Transform methods/parameters shall define the scope of revision comparison.
features.implementation_evidence: revision::Comparison and against_field_mdp scope changed objects.
features.assertions: FieldMDP selection tests cover included and excluded field changes; distinct from DocMDP's update-level timestamp carveout.
features.limitation: B18 remains a separate DocMDP validation/comparison gap; it does not negate FieldMDP scope controls.

features.source_requirement: DocMDP states permitted changes; the permissions dictionary association makes it binding. Table 257 defines P=1/2/3 and default P=2. P=1 has a narrow incremental-update exception for only data necessary to add DSS and/or DTS. P=2/3 enumerate permitted form/annotation changes and likewise permit DSS/DTS updates. EC3 #152 makes /P an integer.
features.implementation_evidence: signature.rs parses DocMDP; revision.rs compares/ranks revisions; restriction.rs applies operation-specific permissions; viewer-core/notes.rs reports change comparison.
features.assertions: Certification level and operation tests cover permitted/refused edits. `a_docmdp_level_written_as_a_real_takes_the_tables_default` deliberately verifies fallback for a non-integer /P; this malformed-value behavior is not a valid-input claim.
features.limitation: Public API DTS-only fixture shows required signature-field/page/catalog registration objects are reported NotClassified under P=1; the valid mixed page-change control is not ranked as unchanged. See B18 and signatures_transforms shard.

features.source_requirement: After integrity verification, compare the signed and current revisions and evaluate modifications under the transform parameters.
features.implementation_evidence: revision::Comparison opens the signed prefix and compares it with current xref state; viewer-core notes consumes the result.
features.assertions: Revision comparison tests use literal added/redefined/deleted-object and operation results; B18 is a counterexample to completeness for the DTS carveout only.

features.source_requirement: Aggregate heading; detailed interoperability requirements are in subclauses.
features.implementation_evidence: Signature parsing, digest, authenticity, trust, reporting implemented by subordinate rows.

features.source_requirement: Signature handlers interoperate through the Filter/SubFilter declarations and the validation parameters; Table 260 enumerates supported combinations.
features.implementation_evidence: pdf-signature dispatches parsing, digest, crypto family and certificate selection; viewer-core reports digest/authenticity/trust as separate results.
features.assertions: cms.rs detached SignedData controls distinguish content type, digest, signer and certificate facts; corpus signature tests exercise digest mutation and signer-certificate binding; signature algorithm tests cover implemented key families.
features.limitation: These controls do not establish every external handler/profile combination or trust policy. Scope boundary: source’s supported rows and host-supplied trust, not a universal validation oracle.

features.source_requirement: CMS signature Contents is DER SignedData; ByteRange identifies signed bytes excluding the Contents hex string; trailing padding is permitted; detached CMS and the specified digest variants are interpreted under RFC 5652. A signer certificate is needed to verify; timestamps/revocation information may also be present.
features.implementation_evidence: pdf-signature/cms.rs parses CMS; signature.rs checks ByteRange/digest/crypto and certificate association.
features.assertions: Parser fixture `cms::a_detached_signature_states_its_algorithm_and_its_message_digest` asserts literal detached content type and digest; corpus tests check digest tampering and signer-certificate binding. Parser fixture alone is not cryptographic verification; integration tests separately establish verification.
features.excluded: §12.8.3.3.2 archival revocation attribute is out of this bounded shard.

features.source_requirement: Aggregate heading plus framing: PAdES signatures use ETSI.CAdES.detached; CMS applies, and compatibility with further CAdES profiles may be obtained with DSS/DTS provisions.
features.implementation_evidence: Signature::pades_departures scopes profile-specific checks to ETSI.CAdES.detached; authenticity dispatch is separately cryptographic.
features.assertions: `a_pades_signature_is_held_to_the_rules_that_need_no_certificate` includes non-PAdES control; PAdES ECDSA integration test establishes a real signature verification path.
features.limitation: Detailed PAdES conditions reside in .4.2–.8, not reviewed as part of this framing artifact; #55’s producer order condition does not itself require a reader-visible warning.

features.locator: printed 585 / physical 600 (heading and §12.8.4.1; continuation to printed 586 / physical 601)
features.source_requirement: §12.8.4 is an aggregate heading. §12.8.4.1 frames LTV as using DSS and DTS dictionaries; the sentence itself states no modal reader duty. DSS structure and its detailed use are delegated to §12.8.4.2–.5; timestamp details are in §12.8.5.
features.implementation_evidence: security_store parser decodes DSS/VRI material; revocation/trust validate cryptographic evidence with host-supplied anchors; Signature::timestamp handles DTS. viewer-core notes reports evidence separately from status.
features.assertions: The current security-store report fixture checks stream/member inventory and a no-DSS control; revocation/path tests separately establish signed evidence and anchor behavior. These do not prove every LTV workflow or historical capture requirement.
features.limitation: No DSS/VRI/DTS producer conformance or whole LTV profile claim. Detailed .4.2–.5 are only referenced here, not re-audited.

features.source_requirement: DTS uses the signature dictionary and RFC 3161 token; its ByteRange covers the complete revision except Contents and the token imprint binds those bytes. Detailed DTS conditions are further subdivided.
features.implementation_evidence: signature.rs coverage; timestamp.rs token parser and establishment; viewer-core notes/report paths.
features.assertions: timestamp/tests.rs checks TSTInfo members, token authority, range coverage and chained timestamp/material coverage. B18 separately tests DocMDP interaction; public historical OCSP finding B47 separately tests §12.8.3.4.8 and does not establish all DTS duties.
features.limitation: This entry does not certify every .5.2/.5.3 edge, timestamp order, trust, or revocation policy.

errata_review.effect: Table 257 /P is integer; current parser fallback for a real-valued malformed /P is covered by a test but is not a valid-value conformance witness.
DTS follows a certification signature when present (producer order). Do not infer a reader must reject otherwise solely from this correction.
Adjacent framing/parameter issues, not exhaustively reviewed in this shard; #121/#219 concern signature dictionary entries/version indications and #117 DigestMethod optionality.

related_existing_findings.relation: Within this shard: DocMDP P=1 DTS-only revision classification failure with valid mixed page-edit control.
Adjacent prior finding: trusted timestamp genTime is used despite authenticated TSA keyCompromise. Not re-audited here.
Outside this shard: selected FieldMDP field rename is classified outside Include(Name). Mentioned to avoid presenting B18 as the only current signature-related finding.
Adjacent prior finding: public current-time report accepts a CRL with thisUpdate after the supplied current UTC time. Preserve historical validation distinction.
Adjacent prior finding: public historical report accepts GOOD OCSP with producedAt before the trusted past timestamp; distinct from B41 and from LTV capture-time evidence.
